answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and runs a beacon on a lagoon canyon rim. Randomly, the beacon demands a heartbeat chained by a signed thread, blocking precomputed beats. A missed beat or broken thread burns the bond. First heartbeat: 38 credits; the k-th: 38+8(k-1), one node per slot. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 4,034,000 plus 70,000 locked; honest agents pay 38 once. Auditors replay the thread on the canyon log, catching a rented-beacon ring.
